scripts.build: bunx --bun --no-install tsc --noEmit && bunx --bun --no-install agent-tool --repo ../.. images build favicons --out packages/app-capacitor/public && bunx --bun --no-install vite build
scripts.cap:prepare: bunx --bun --no-install agent-tool --repo ../.. images build native && bun scripts/prepareMobile.ts
scripts.cap:sync:debug: bun run cap:prepare && bunx --bun --no-install cap sync
scripts.cap:sync:release: bun run cap:prepare && NATIVE_RELEASE_TIER=production bunx --bun --no-install cap sync
scripts.cap:sync:staging: bun run cap:prepare && NATIVE_RELEASE_TIER=staging bunx --bun --no-install cap sync
